findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email-verify, extract-page, news-search, rss-parse · Private data: check-domain, crypto-news, email-verify, generate-uuid, pii-detect, token-lookup, transcribe-audio · Public sink: email-find, email-send, email-verify, send-email, session-message, webhook-send · Destructive: convert-format, diff-text, generate-uuid, image-remove-bg, jsonpath-query, phone-validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email-verify, extract-page, news-search, rss-parse · Private data: check-domain, crypto-news, email-verify, generate-uuid, pii-detect, token-lookup, transcribe-audio · Public sink: email-find, email-send, email-verify, send-email, session-message, webhook-send · Destructive: convert-format, diff-text, generate-uuid, image-remove-bg, jsonpath-query, phone-validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
